calibration.objective: positional NLL including trailing padding on original validation crops

positional_label_coverage.interpretation: Missing positive label exposure is not an accuracy or impossibility claim

declarations.format_sampling: uniform format, then uniform supported character per position; unique identities
limitations: Synthetic glyphs are not a substitute for real-camera training and held-out evaluation
Explicit fonts do not establish legal registration typography or jurisdiction coverage
Finite samples need a positional class-coverage audit before training

decoder_constraints: trailing padding only; no country-format or known-plate prior
limitations: Positional ECE and NLL do not establish whole-plate confidence calibration
Synthetic degradation of a crop is not a substitute for naturally blurred real captures
Temperature fitted on original validation crops may not transfer to stronger corruption
Transferred validation calibration does not establish calibration on a different camera domain
Dataset provenance records source declarations, not independent verification of annotation accuracy
Latency includes image reading and preprocessing; decoder timing is reported separately
